line: Transactional key-value storage with hosted and SQLite-backed options.

cells.metered: Pro $20/month per organization; KV overages apply

cells.selfhost: Yes, MIT denokv server or local SQLite

sql.math: Assumes a verified Free organization. 0.931 GiB, 100,000 reads and 20,000 writes fit within the monthly allowances.
Keeping 0.931 GiB stays within the Free plan's 1 GiB allowance. There are no requests or jobs.

files.math: Deno KV has no separate file storage.

jobs.math: 10K scheduled Cron runs, each taking 1 CPU-second, use 2.78 CPU hours and an assumed 10 GiB-hours. This fits the Free plan if other app usage leaves room in those limits.
